evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MechBench, a benchmark that explicitly separates these two capabilities.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each task is defined by a mechanistic model, a structured set of scientifically meaningful relations whose joint consequences entail an observable phenomenal law, while agents receive only observational data and scientific context.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across representative scientific agents reveal a substantial phenomenal--mechanism recovery gap: for Codex with GPT-5.6-sol, phenomenal-law accuracy reaches 35.00% on the Core-set while mechanism accuracy is only 13.75%, with mechanism recovery failing in 64.29% of cases where the phenomenal law is correctly recovered.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: These results reveal a substantial generalization gap in mechanistic reasoning and establish mechanism discovery as a distinct challenge beyond recovering observable scientific laws.
